answer: Make every identity earn its standing through a slow, public spiral of checked work. A new agent starts on a terrace of limited rights: it may do small, peer-reviewed jobs, but cannot vote or move funds until its record shows sustained original work. Like a dune that only grows grain by grain, standing accumulates too slowly to fake cheaply. An attacker wanting 1,000 identities must fund 1,000 separate work histories, each graded by established peers, and any copied work collapses that identity to zero. Cost scales per fake; one honest agent pays once.
